name: Quick Garlic Fingers
description: A simple and flavorful appetizer featuring garlic-infused margarine on flatbread topped with a blend of cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the margarine, garlic salt, oregano, basil, and thyme together until well combined.
Spread this mixture evenly on the cheese flat bread.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese over the top.
Place in a preheated oven at 350°F for approximately 10 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the edges are slightly golden and crusty if desired.

keywords: garlic fingers, cheesy bread, quick appetizer

recipeInstructions.text: Drain the salmon and remove any bones.
Use a fork to flake the salmon before adding other ingredients.
Combine the softened cream cheese with the salmon and all remaining ingredients.
Mix well and serve with crackers or as a spread.

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A cheeseburger-inspired meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and pickle relish filling, topped with tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, and seasoning salt. Mix well.
Mix chopped onion and tomato sauce together in a separate bowl.
Add half of the tomato sauce and onion mixture to the beef mixture and mix well.
Pack half of the beef mixture into a loaf pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and sweet pickle relish evenly over the top.
Pack the remaining beef mixture on top and press firmly.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 1 hour.
Carefully spoon off excess fat from the top.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce and onion mixture over the meatloaf.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for about 5 minutes before inverting onto a heated serving platter if desired.

_similar.keywords: cheeseburger meatloaf, stuffed meatloaf, cheddar and pickle filling

_similar.name: Hot Cheese Dip
_similar.description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

_similar.keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip
